title: 第1章 生人坑一半熟人大满贯第2章 我就是我不一样的坑货
slug: 我被系统坑成了造物主
content_zh:
龙影大陆
凤仙宗
主峰中一间偏僻而雅致院落，仙气袅袅，屋内传来阵阵抽泣声，一俊俏女子，身着青衣，双肩耸动，口中一遍遍喊道，“云天哥哥，你醒醒啊！
！”
叮！
恭喜宿主，系统已就绪，请指示。
叮！
叮叮！
叮叮叮！
躺在床上的公子，一张俊美的脸庞突然睁开眼睛，双眼无神，若仔细观看其眼晴中有一道蓝光闪烁。
躲在床上的青年，缓缓动了动眼睛，心中大骇“我穿越了？，还有系统？”
姜云天，来自地球的大好的青年，996的标杆，43岁老处男，学医两年后转学计算机，后成了设计院里的古建设计和修复的设计总监，卒于工作岗位，现在却在这异世重生了。
听着身边美娇娘的的嘤嘤抽泣，姜云天看了看正在低头哭泣的嘤嘤怪，大脑慢慢开始运转，并与原身的记忆慢慢重合。
原身亦叫作姜云天，是龙影大陆凤仙宗宗主姜山的庶长子，体弱多病，倍受家族嫌弃，劣等木灵根，26岁，炼气一重，身中剧毒，命悬一线。
姜云天探查了自己的身体，心中呐喊“玛德，刚穿过来就死，真坑啊！
！”
一个慵懒的男声音响起：“真坑啊，”
声音回复道。
嗯，姜云天猛然一惊，“我有系统，会不会还有转机？”
姜云天立即用心神打开系统，开始对话：

“万能的系统啊，救救我！

The young master lying on the bed suddenly opened his eyes with a handsome face. His eyes were dull. If you look closely, there was a flash of blue light in his eyes.
The young man hiding on the bed slowly moved his eyes and was horrified, "I have traveled through time? And there is still a system?"
Jiang Yuntian, a great young man from the earth, the benchmark of 996, a 43-year-old virgin, studied medicine for two years and then switched to computer science, and later became the design director of the design and restoration of ancient buildings in the design institute. He died at his job, but now he is reborn in this other world.
Listening to the sobs of the beautiful girl next to him, Jiang Yuntian looked at the crying monster who was lowering his head and crying. His brain slowly started to work and slowly overlapped with the original memory.
His original name is also Jiang Yuntian, and he is the eldest son of Jiang Shan, the leader of Fengxian Sect in Longying Continent. He is frail and sickly, and is disliked by his family. He has inferior wood spirit roots. He is 26 years old, has a first level of Qi refining, is poisoned, and his life hangs by a thread.
Jiang Yuntian explored his body and shouted in his heart, "Made, you will die as soon as you pass through. What a trap!"
